<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a PR. Solve one problem per PR.
Use a conventional commit title in plain language, such as "fix(web): new threads no longer spike CPU".
-->

## Problem

<!-- Explain the problem in a sentence or two. Include expected behavior and
reproduction steps or environment where relevant. Link the issue or discussion if there is one. -->

## Change

<!-- Explain how this fixes the problem. If it spans components or clients,
explain why those changes are needed for the same fix. -->

## Verification

<!-- Describe the focused tests or manual checks you ran and what you observed.
State anything you could not check. "Tests pass" alone is not enough.

For UI changes, include before and after screenshots. Add a short recording when
motion or timing matters. Upload evidence to GitHub; never commit PR-only assets. -->

<!-- If you used an agent, end with the model and harness that did the work. -->
